cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.title: Conversations
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.what1: If you asked the AI for something yesterday, you can return to that conversation today and pick up where you left off.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.what2: Each conversation keeps a record of what you said to each other. Folders work like drawers: they keep conversations from the same place together so they are easier to find.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.step1: Search for a conversation by name. You can also look inside the folders.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.step2: Check the status label. It tells you whether the AI is Working, Waiting for you, or Resting.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.step3: Tap the conversation. Write what you need in the box at the bottom.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.step4: Tap Send. Only then does the AI receive your message and start working.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.example1Text: Yesterday, you asked the AI to prepare a proposal. Today, you find that conversation by name, open it, and write “change the date.” When you tap Send, the AI continues the same work.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.example2Titl: Example: find one part of a long conversation
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.example2Text: The conversation has many messages, and you want to return to an earlier decision. Tap Index to see a list of the important parts. Opening that list does not ask the AI to do any new work.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.legend1Text: It works like a drawer. It keeps several conversations from the same place together.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.legend2Text: It helps you find a conversation by typing part of its name.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.legend3Text: They show options to rename, move, or archive something.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.legend4Text: It marks a conversation that has been stored separately from the ones you use now.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.action1Text: Creates a new drawer wherever you choose. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.action2Text: Helps you find a conversation and open it. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.action3Text: Lets you rename the conversation, move it to a folder, or archive it. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.action4Text: Delivers your message to the AI so it can continue the work.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.action5Text: Shows a list of the parts of the conversation so you can jump to one. Opening it does not ask the AI to do any new work.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.action6Text: Shows the materials saved during the conversation. Opening them does not ask the AI to do any new work.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.action7Text: Rebuilds the list with the most recent messages.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.action8Text: Takes you to the most recent message and clears the new-message notice. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.conversaciones.warn: “Working” means the AI is busy. “Waiting for you” means it is ready for you or needs you to accept or reject a permission request. “Resting” means there is no work in progress. If a conversation says “Archived” or “Terminal Mode,” you can read it here, but you cannot continue it from this box. If you delete a folder, the conversations inside it are not deleted.
cabina.ayuda.salas.title: Shared rooms
cabina.ayuda.salas.what1: Imagine a table where several people write messages to reach an agreement. The room’s AI, called Cucho, does not read that conversation while you are talking among yourselves.
cabina.ayuda.salas.what2: Cucho receives what you have written only when someone taps ✦ Send to AI. Talking with other people does not cost anything.
cabina.ayuda.salas.step1: Open a room that already exists. If you need another one, create it and give it a clear name.
cabina.ayuda.salas.step2: Write your message and tap Send to room. The other people will see it, and it does not cost anything.
cabina.ayuda.salas.step3: Write @cucho at the beginning of a question if you want to mark it for the AI. This does not send it yet.
cabina.ayuda.salas.step4: When the group is ready, tap ✦ Send to AI. Only then does Cucho read the relevant messages and respond.
cabina.ayuda.salas.example1Title: Example: agree before asking for help
cabina.ayuda.salas.example1Text: Three people are reviewing a budget. They write to each other for a while to reach an agreement. Once they know what they want to ask, one person taps ✦ Send to AI. Only then does Cucho read everything together and respond.
cabina.ayuda.salas.example2Title: Example: send only one marked question
cabina.ayuda.salas.example2Text: The group has been discussing several topics. Someone writes “@cucho how much do these expenses add up to?” and then taps ✦ Send to AI. Cucho receives that marked question; everything else waits for another send.
cabina.ayuda.salas.legend1Text: They mark a room where several people participate.
cabina.ayuda.salas.legend2Text: It appears beside the button that delivers the written messages to Cucho.
cabina.ayuda.salas.action1Text: Lets you enter the group’s space or set up a new one. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.salas.action2Text: Shows your message to the other people. It does not cost anything and waits until someone delivers it to Cucho.
cabina.ayuda.salas.action3Text: People can use them to mark agreement, a question, or a blocker. They do not cost anything, and Cucho does not receive them.
cabina.ayuda.salas.action4Text: Repeats part of the message you are replying to above your answer, so the group knows what you mean. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.salas.action5Text: Delivers to Cucho everything that has been waiting since the last send.
cabina.ayuda.salas.action6Text: Rebuilds the list of sections with the most recent messages.
cabina.ayuda.salas.action7Text: Asks Cucho to stop the current work. It appears only while Cucho is working.
cabina.ayuda.salas.action8Text: Shows the agreements that were written down. Opening it does not ask the AI to do any new work.
cabina.ayuda.salas.action9Text: Shows a list of the important parts of the conversation. Opening it does not ask the AI to do any new work.
cabina.ayuda.salas.action10Text: Shows the materials saved in the room. Opening them does not ask the AI to do any new work.
cabina.ayuda.salas.action11Text: Takes you to the most recent message. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.salas.action12Text: The owner can invite people. Everyone else can leave the room. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.salas.warn: Writing @cucho only marks a question; it does not deliver it. If there are marked questions when you tap ✦ Send to AI, Cucho receives only those questions, and everything else keeps waiting. If none are marked, Cucho receives everything written since the previous send. If Cucho is already busy, the new request waits its turn.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.title: The Forge · your files
cabina.ayuda.archivos.what1: If you saved a photo, a document, or a PDF, you can find, view, and organize it here.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.what2: The Forge shows your files, which are saved items, and your folders, which work like drawers for grouping them.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.step1: To enter a folder, tap it twice in a row, or select it and tap Open.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.step2: Tap a saved item. On one side, you will see its name, size, and, when possible, its contents.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.step3: Tap Upload files to choose something from your device and save it in the folder you are viewing.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.step4: Tap the three dots if you want to download, rename, or move something to the Trash.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.example1Title: Example: save an invoice in the right place
cabina.ayuda.archivos.example1Text: You enter the “Invoices 2026” folder and tap Upload files. You choose the invoice from your device. Because you opened the right folder first, the invoice is saved there.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.example2Text: You find a PDF and do not remember what it contains. You select it and tap Preview to look at it without downloading it to your device. This does not ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.legend1Text: It works like a drawer. Tapping it opens another group of saved items.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.legend2Text: It represents a saved item. Its color helps you recognize what type it is.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.legend3Text: Saves something from your device on this screen.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.legend4Text: Shows the contents without downloading them, when possible.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.legend5Text: Downloads something from this screen to your device.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.legend6Text: They show more things you can do.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.legend7Text: Removes the selected item from the folder and sends it to the Trash.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.action1Text: Creates a new drawer for organizing your things. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.action2Text: Saves items you choose from your device here. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.action3Text: Sorts by name, size, or date. It also switches between rows and tiles. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.action4Text: Open a folder or show images, PDFs, and documents that this screen can read. They don't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.action5Text: Downloads an item to your device. If you choose a folder, it gathers everything into one compressed package. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.action6Text: Gives the selected item a new name. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.action7Text: Removes the selected item from the current folder and sends it to the Trash. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.archivos.warn: Some saved items cannot be displayed on this screen. If they are very large or use a format it does not recognize, you will be offered the option to download them. If something says “Link,” it is a shortcut that takes you somewhere else. Before uploading or dragging something, check the name of the open folder so you do not save it in the wrong place.
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.title: Connections · your accounts
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.what1: For example, you can connect your Microsoft 365 account so the AI can help you with email or your calendar.
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.what2: You can also connect Zoho or Freshservice. Before you do, each card explains in plain language what the AI will and will not be able to do.
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.step1: Choose the account you want to connect. Read what the AI will be able to do with it.
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.step2: Tap Connect account. Microsoft and Zoho open their own pages. Freshservice asks for the information on this screen.
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.step3: When you finish those steps, return to Connections. Wait until you see the word Connected.
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.step4: If you no longer want the AI to use that account, tap Disconnect.
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.example1Text: You want the AI to help you organize meetings. Tap Connect account on the Microsoft 365 card and follow the steps shown by Microsoft. When you return, wait for the Connected mark before asking for help with your calendar.
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.example2Text: You no longer want the AI to work with your Zoho account. Tap Disconnect on its card. From that moment on, the AI no longer has that access.
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.legend1Text: Confirms that the account is connected.
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.legend2Text: Takes you to the service’s page to continue connecting the account.
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.legend3Text: Copies a code or the list of required permissions.
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.legend4Text: Tries again after a connection was interrupted or encountered an error.
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.action1Text: Starts the steps for granting access to that account. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.action2Text: Copies the information you will need in the next step. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.action3Text: Opens that service’s secure page. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.action4Text: Checks your Freshservice account using the information you entered. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.action5Text: Restarts a connection that did not finish. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.action6Text: Stops the attempt or removes access to a connected account. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.conexiones.warn: The AI does not receive your password. It only receives the permissions shown on each card. In Freshservice, it can work only with the information your own account can already view and change. Microsoft and Zoho codes expire quickly and can be used only once. The Freshservice key is checked and then is no longer shown on this screen.
cabina.ayuda.como-trabajo.title: How I work · your preferences
cabina.ayuda.como-trabajo.what1: For example, you can write that you prefer short answers. The AI will keep that instruction in mind in future conversations.
cabina.ayuda.como-trabajo.what2: This screen brings your work instructions together. It also shows the information available to the AI so it knows how to introduce you.
cabina.ayuda.como-trabajo.step1: Under Behavior, tap one of the boxes. Each box stores one part of your instructions.
cabina.ayuda.como-trabajo.step2: Read the text. If you see Open and adjust, you can change it. If you see View, you can only read it.
cabina.ayuda.como-trabajo.step3: Tap Review before saving. You will see clearly which part will be removed and which part will remain.
cabina.ayuda.como-trabajo.step4: If it looks right, tap Yes, apply this change. If not, tap Keep editing and correct it.
cabina.ayuda.como-trabajo.example1Text: You open a box you can adjust and add “Use short sentences and explain difficult words.” Tap Review before saving to compare the versions. If the result says what you want, apply the change.
cabina.ayuda.como-trabajo.example2Text: A box says “Maintained automatically.” Tap View to read it. There is no option to change it from this screen.
cabina.ayuda.como-trabajo.legendNote: On this screen, the main controls are written as words. Labels such as “Open and adjust,” “View,” and “Maintained automatically” tell you what you can do with each box.
cabina.ayuda.como-trabajo.action1Text: Shows your latest instructions and information again. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.como-trabajo.action2Text: Opens a box you can change. View opens one you can only read. They don't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.como-trabajo.action3Text: Asks the AI to compare the old text with the new text and explain the change to you.
cabina.ayuda.como-trabajo.action4Text: Returns to the text without saving anything. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.como-trabajo.action5Text: Saves the reviewed instruction for future conversations. It does not start another AI review.
cabina.ayuda.como-trabajo.warn: Only one box is changed at a time. The others stay as they were. You can read boxes that say “Maintained automatically,” but you cannot change them here. If the automatic explanation fails, you will still see the old and new text side by side so you can decide.
cabina.ayuda.lecciones.title: Lessons · what it learned
cabina.ayuda.lecciones.what1: For example, if you ask for short titles several times, the AI may suggest remembering that preference.
cabina.ayuda.lecciones.what2: This is where you will see things the AI noticed because they appeared repeatedly in the way you work. Nothing is kept unless you decide to keep it.
cabina.ayuda.lecciones.step1: Start with the Awaiting decision group. This is where you will find suggestions waiting for your response.
cabina.ayuda.lecciones.step2: Tap a suggestion. Read What I noticed and The general lesson.
cabina.ayuda.lecciones.step3: Check how many times it happened and how confident the AI is that it understood correctly.
cabina.ayuda.lecciones.step4: Choose whether to keep or discard it. Afterward, it will remain visible in the corresponding group.
cabina.ayuda.lecciones.example1Text: The AI noticed several times that you ask for dates with the month written out. You open the suggestion and confirm that it understood correctly. Tap Yes, keep this lesson to save it.
cabina.ayuda.lecciones.example2Text: A suggestion says you always want formal answers, but that only happened once. Tap No, discard it and confirm. The suggestion moves to the Discarded group so you can see what you decided.
cabina.ayuda.lecciones.legendNote: The ⛔, 📏, 🧭, 📋, 🔧, and 📝 symbols separate lessons by type: rule, usual format, way of working, steps, tool, and note. The labels also show whether a decision is still needed and how many times something happened.
cabina.ayuda.lecciones.action1Text: Shows the latest list again. It does not ask the AI to do any new work.
cabina.ayuda.lecciones.action2Text: Shows what the AI noticed, what it suggests remembering, how many times it happened, and how confident it is. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.lecciones.action3Text: Saves the suggestion with the approved ones. It does not ask the AI to do any new work.
cabina.ayuda.lecciones.action4Text: Asks you to confirm, then moves it to Discarded. Doesn't ask the AI to do any work.
cabina.ayuda.lecciones.warn: Something is not approved automatically just because it happens many times. Suggestions wait for your decision. A discarded lesson remains visible under Discarded. A lesson already in use appears with the approved ones.
cabina.ayuda.costWork: This does ask the AI to do work
cabina.ayuda.indexIntro: Not sure where to start? Choose the screen you are looking at. You will find short steps and examples you can try without worry.
